items.description: Report does not give numeric validUntil/validAfter values or a concrete window, so the enforcement relation is carried by the grounded Boolean window_authenticated_by_signature rather than a numeric time comparison.
Report does not state the concrete validUntil/validAfter values or the signer-approved window bounds, so the outside-window relation is carried as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.
Whether the rewritten operation actually executes depends on EntryPoint validation and bundling not described in the report.

Report does not give a numeric definition of the time-window bounds (validUntil/validAfter values) or the signer-approved window, so the window relation is carried as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.
Report does not state whether the relayer is permissionless or specifically authorized; the protected-action condition is limited to holders of a valid signed operation.
Whether the rewritten operation actually executes depends on EntryPoint validation and bundling not described in the report; the execution outcome cannot be bound from supplied statements.
